items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Don Byas asked me... why don't you come on and take this job because I'm going to join Duke Ellington's orchestra... it turned out that he didn't get with Duke Ellington, Al Sears had gotten the job.

ctx.x: Any way we played this club and Duke Ellington at that time was out there, and Orson Welles and all of them were behind him, and they were producing 'jump for joy.'
